display.purpose: Page title (h1) — used once per view. Clamped from 1.5rem to 1.875rem.

headline.purpose: KPI numbers, chart value labels. Always with tabular-nums.

body.purpose: All prose content, transaction descriptions, alert messages. Max 75ch.

label.purpose: KPI category labels, form labels, table column headers. Uppercase, tight tracking.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Default card shadow (Tailwind shadow-sm). Barely-there separation.

shadows.name: elevated
shadows.purpose: Hover elevation for interactive cards and active nav items (Tailwind shadow).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action button. Navy background, white text, compact h-8 sizing.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; gap: 0.375rem; border-radius: 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #1e3a8a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action button. Transparent bg, slate border, ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; gap: 0.375rem; border-radius: 0.625rem; border: 1px solid #dbe4ee; background: transparent; color: #020617; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #eef2f7; color: #020617; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #1e3a8a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.5); }

components.name: KPI Card
components.description: Metric display card used in the dashboard KPI grid. Contains label, value, and optional delta.
components.css: .ds-kpi-card { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 1.125rem; border: 1px solid rgba(219, 228, 238, 0.9); background: #ffffff; padding: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-kpi-card:hover { border-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.3); } .ds-kpi-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-kpi-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #475569; } .ds-kpi-delta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.125rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-kpi-up { color: #059669; } .ds-kpi-down { color: #e11d48; } .ds-kpi-value { display: block; margin-top: 0.25rem; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-kpi-positive { color: #059669; } .ds-kpi-negative { color: #e11d48; }

components.name: Bottom Nav Item
components.description: Navigation item in the bottom app bar. Single icon + label stack. Active state: navy bg, white icon/label.
components.html: DashboardMovimientos
components.css: .ds-nav-bar { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.25rem; border-radius: 1.125rem; border: 1px solid rgba(219, 228, 238, 0.8); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #475569; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #eef2f7; color: #020617; } .ds-nav-active { background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field. Slate border, rounded-lg, focus ring in blue-deep.
components.css: .ds-input-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #475569; } .ds-input { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.625rem; border: 1px solid #dbe4ee; background: transparent; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #020617; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #475569; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #1e3a8a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.5); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #e11d48; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.2); }

narrative.overview: Every screen reads like a page from a well-kept ledger — no-nonsense, honest, personal. This is not a bank app, a fintech demo, or a gamified budget tool. It is a calm, clear view of where money is, what was spent, and whether the budget is on track. The system is cool-toned and restrained: slate and navy neutrals, a blue accent used sparingly, and semantic color reserved for moments where the user actually needs to react. Layout is compact and efficient, rewarding a 30-second glance while supporting deeper inspection.
keyCharacteristics: Cool slate-and-navy palette — never warm, never cream, never sand
Single font family (IBM Plex Sans) at weights 400 / 500 / 600 — unity, not pairing drama
Card-driven dashboard: each KPI, chart, and alert is an independent rounded container on a fixed subtle-gradient background
Bottom-nav glass sheet as the primary navigation (mobile-first, no sidebar)
Compact controls: h-8 buttons, tight padding, small type — the tool stays out of the way
Semantic color is informational, not decorative — emerald and rose carry real financial signal
Dark mode inverts the palette without introducing new hues — the same slate-and-navy values, just reordered

rules.name: The Named-Message Rule
rules.body: Semantic color always carries a label or icon. Color is redundant support, not the sole channel.

rules.name: The No-Pairing Rule
rules.body: One font, all weights. No serif companion, no display font, no mono for contrast.

rules.name: The One-Cue-Too-Many Rule
rules.body: Never combine border + shadow + background-tint + gradient on the same container. Pick two, at most three.

dos: Do use slate-and-navy cool neutrals. The background is paper (#f8fafc), not cream, sand, or warm beige.
Do make body text reach ≥4.5:1 against its background. Ink on paper passes; ink on any tinted surface requires checking.
Do use semantic color (emerald / rose / amber / orange) only for financial signals that carry meaning, not for decoration.
Do accompany every colored value with a text or icon label — color is redundant reinforcement, never the sole channel.
Do use tabular-nums on all monetary amounts so digits don't shift width as values change.
Do cap the page at max-w-5xl (64rem). Content should not stretch across wide monitors.
Do apply text-wrap: balance on h1 headings for even line lengths.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce on every animation.
donts: Don't use a warm-tinted background (cream, sand, beige, bone, parchment, linen, ivory, biscuit).
Don't create hero-metric layouts with a giant number, small label, supporting stats, and gradient accent.
Don't put tiny uppercase tracking-heavy eyebrows above every section.
Don't apply side-stripe borders (border-left greater than 1px as a colored accent on cards or list items).
Don't use glassmorphism as a default surface treatment.
Don't nest cards. One card, one container.
Don't ship animated layouts (animating width/height/top/left). Use transform and opacity only.
Don't create alarm fatigue with multiple simultaneous toasts.
Don't hardcode the author's name or personal data into UI strings.
